anc-gund-abc-eels.title: ABC Deep Time / Gunditj Mirring Traditional Owners: Budj Bim eel traps
anc-gund-abc-eels.notes: Gunditj Mirring credited for eel aquaculture, gnarraban and food preparation; do not reproduce its prose.

anc-gund-abc-huts.title: ABC Deep Time / Gunditj Mirring Traditional Owners: Budj Bim stone huts
anc-gund-abc-huts.notes: Indigenous custodians credited for dwellings and their positioning; original account not reproduced.

anc-gund-nyamat.title: Gunditj Mirring Traditional Owners Aboriginal Corporation: Nyamat Mirring Plan 2023–2033
anc-gund-nyamat.notes: Print pp. 8, 15–17: four Countries, Deen Maar as Sea Country and public named testimony of Tyson Lovett Murray. All rights reserved; no text reproduction.

anc-gund-nomination.title: Australian Government / Gunditjmara: Budj Bim Cultural Landscape World Heritage Nomination (2017)
anc-gund-nomination.notes: Print pp. 36–38, 44–53, 67–70: underlying sources include Gunditjmara 2010 (with Gib Wettenhall); colonial resistance, mission, and lake drainage. Distinguish owner account from institutional paraphrase.

anc-gund-soe.title: Australian Government, State of the Environment 2021: Budj Bim heritage case study
anc-gund-soe.notes: Quotes Aunty Eileen Alberts in Gunditjmara people with Wettenhall 2010. Attribution must be retained; do not reproduce long quotations.

anc-gund-unesco.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Budj Bim Cultural Landscape
anc-gund-unesco.notes: Confirms multiple complexes, aquaculture at least 6600 years, restoration of Tae Rak, ownership/management, July 2019 listing; not authority for Indigenous spiritual accounts.

anc-gund-gov.title: Australian Government: Budj Bim Cultural Landscape world heritage place
anc-gund-gov.notes: Tungatt Mirring, Tyrendarra flow, wetlands and ecology, aquaculture and guardianship.

anc-gund-geology.notes: 36.9±3.1 ka Budj Bim (95% CI), 36.8±3.8 ka Tower Hill; stone tool under Tower Hill tephra, NOT Budj Bim. Oral-history connection framed as a possibility.

anc-gund-museum.title: National Museum of Australia: Budj Bim Cultural Landscape
anc-gund-museum.notes: Gunditjmara occupation, trade and homes, resistance, mission, 1987 return; names Denis Rose in 2019.

anc-kl-myths.title: Crater Lake Institute: Indians 08 - Myths of Crater Lake (excerpt of cultural history)
anc-kl-myths.notes: Le+w / Sqel / Old Mink; daughter and stolen heart, Weasel and Gmokamc, ball game, recovery, crawfish, Wizard Island; distinguishes NPS-linked versions. Quoted material not reproduced.

anc-kl-biblio.title: Crater Lake Institute: Indians 09 - literature and witness references

anc-kl-livo.title: Stefan Livo, Giiwas/Crater Lake, University of Rostock (2018)
anc-kl-livo.notes: Separate Colvig/Lalek records and source criticism; summarizes Applegate, Gatschet, Curtin and heart-ball variant; early park promoters and Indigenous land ties.

anc-kl-applegate.title: Oliver C. Applegate, The Klamath Legend of La-o, Steel Points 1(2):75-76 (1907)
anc-kl-applegate.notes: Applegate 1907 story excerpt in Linda W. Greene 1984 NPS Historic Resource Study printed pp. 34-36; Skell, Llao, antelope, eagle and dove. NOT Robert David Klamath transcript.

anc-kl-trager.title: Martelle W. Trager, National Parks of the Northwest (1939), pp. 165-67
anc-kl-trager.notes: Reprinted in Greene NPS 1984 printed pp. 39-41; adds Coyote, Fox, chase, wrestling, louse bite and Skell beheading Llao. Distinct from 1907 Applegate.

anc-kl-travel.title: Julia Rosen, The Creation of Crater Lake, with Klamath culture director Perry Chocktoot (2018)
anc-kl-travel.notes: Reporter attributes account heard in childhood to Perry Chocktoot: woman refusal, kyoks, creator Gmo'Kam'c, fire, restrained harvesting and Giiwas. Secondary publication of attributed Indigenous voice, not a licensed full performance.

anc-kl-tribes-history.title: The Klamath Tribes, Our History
anc-kl-tribes-history.notes: Klamath, Modoc and Yahooskin people; Gmok'am'c, precolonial homeland, treaty 1864, termination 1954, restoration 1986; tribal voice authoritative for its history.

anc-kl-tribes-language.title: The Klamath Tribe, Klamath Words and Phrases (1989)
anc-kl-tribes-language.notes: Tribal Cultural Heritage Program publication; credits Robert David as a linguistic knowledge contributor to M. A. R. Barker; no permission to republish Klamath original passages.

anc-kl-ohs.title: Cain Allen, Crater Lake and the Klamath, Oregon Historical Society (2003)
anc-kl-ohs.notes: Draws on Deur 2002 and other studies; Klamath sacred use and vision seeking, false claim that people never approached Crater Lake, continuing traditions and subsistence.

anc-kl-nps.title: US National Park Service, Crater Lake National Park: History and Culture
anc-kl-nps.notes: NPS notes pre-eruption human occupation in area and archaeological evidence beneath ash and pumice; historical interpretation about Indigenous access is simplified and should be balanced with OHS/tribal voices.

anc-kl-usgs.title: US Geological Survey, Eruption History for Mount Mazama and Crater Lake Caldera (2023)
anc-kl-usgs.notes: Explosive eruption and caldera formation about 7,700 years ago; post-collapse activity; no direct dating of oral narration.

anc-kl-usgs-sheet.title: US Geological Survey and NPS, Mount Mazama and Crater Lake: Growth and Destruction of a Cascade Volcano, FS 092-02 (2002)
anc-kl-usgs-sheet.notes: Pumice/ash near Llao Rock about 7,900 years ago; caldera and postcollapse Wizard Island, continuing lake fill; page text reviewed and first-page screenshot inspected.

anc-kl-wiki-tribes.title: Wikipedia: Klamath Tribes
anc-kl-wiki-tribes.notes: General orientation; never primary authority for community history or living oral narrative.

anc-kl-wiki-lake.title: Wikipedia: Crater Lake
anc-kl-wiki-lake.notes: General orientation and geography, not a source of traditional authority.

anc-kl-wiki-mazama.title: Wikipedia: Mount Mazama
anc-kl-wiki-mazama.notes: General volcano orientation; prefer USGS for geology.

anc-kl-wiki-island.title: Wikipedia: Wizard Island
anc-kl-wiki-island.notes: Geographic background only; no narrative authority.

anc-kl-wiki-language.title: Wikipedia: Klamath language
anc-kl-wiki-language.notes: Background only; tribal guide preferred for terminology.

anc-hesiod-wiki.title: Wikipedia: Hesiod

anc-genesis-wiki.title: Wikipedia: Book of Genesis

anc-genesis-joseph-wiki.title: Wikipedia: Joseph (Genesis)
anc-genesis-joseph-wiki.notes: For character names and onward orientation.

anc-pan-kalila-wiki.title: Wikipedia: Kalila wa-Dimna
